ai_credit_rates.notes: Drawn from the Company's pool. The Company sets a monthly cap for the widget (default 600 credits). The default is deliberately small: at the visitor mix in 11 section 8.6 (about 41 credits per visitor) it funds only about 15 visitors a month, so owners raise it and fund it with packs for spring campaigns (one-tap "raise cap" from the cap alert). On Starter (300 included credits) the setup wizard recommends funding the widget from purchased packs only, so it cannot use up the office's allowance. Anonymous visitors get 1 teaser set; more after one-time-code verification, per the gate modes in 11 AIM-AUD-01. The widget is on by default for every Company with AI mockups (24 section 1.6, OD-33)

trial_and_offers.rule: 14 days of Grow features. No card required. Field seats unlimited. 500 AI credits. Payments live once Stripe is connected (it is the Company's own account)
Trials started between Nov 1 and Feb 28 default to 30 days, because buyers are evaluating during the planning season
+14 days if the trial completes 4 of 6 onboarding milestones (import clients, connect Stripe, send a proposal, schedule a visit, invite a crew member, connect bank feed)
Every trial can toggle a fully populated sample Company ("Greenleaf Grounds Co.", 120 clients, a year of visits, designs, invoices, GL) to explore before importing their own data
Disabled until the Company submits 10DLC brand and campaign registration (started on day 1 from a guided form). Email and push work immediately. See Marketing
Choose a plan, or the tenant drops into a read-only state for 60 days (exports allowed), then archive

A paying Company can trial a service-line module its plan does not include (for example Tree Care or Snow & Ice) for 30 days, once per module per Company. The length is operator-configurable (the operator manages entitlements and trials in the admin console). No charge during the trial; the add-on bills from conversion. At expiry with open commitments (a live storm event, enrolled programs) the module winds down instead of switching off, so no client work is stranded. Separate from the account trial above, during which every module the trial plan includes is simply available. Mechanics in 14 section 4.0.3

Companies that sign an annual Grow or Pro plan by Feb 15 and complete the onboarding checklist are guaranteed live (imported, crews on app, first invoices sent) by Mar 31, or the first 3 months are free

The first 100 paying Companies in the Great Lakes Regions (22 section 4.6) get 25% off base plan list price for as long as they stay subscribed, plus the Price Lock Promise and a direct line to the founder. No advisory board (24 section 1.5, R26-12)

entitlement_ux.source: Blueprint convention (proposed here; consistent with 21 §5.2 and 22 §4.1)
rules: Module the Company has not enabled (Snow & Ice not added, Books off because QuickBooks is the system of record, a service line not offered): hidden from navigation for everyone (21 §5.2: 'hidden, not greyed out').

Capability not in the plan ('-') or sold as an add-on ('A'): visible to roles that can buy (owner; anyone with rootline_subscription write) as a locked entry with the plan or add-on that unlocks it and its price; hidden for every other role.

Capability included with limits ('L'): fully usable; the limit is shown where it bites (for example '5 of 5 automation rules active') with an upgrade path for the owner and 'Ask Erin to upgrade' for others.
Never block a Company from getting paid: invoicing, the portal, client payments and the ledger stay available through dunning, Winter Mode and limit overruns (22 §4.1 rule 5).
Never block a Company from getting paid (22 §4.1 rule 5).
Usage is visible before it is billed: every AI action shows its credit cost before it runs.
Seat type is derived from permissions, not the role name (22 §4.3).
Snow Lite is included in every plan.
An add-on that a higher tier includes is removed on upgrade with prorated credit; removing an add-on keeps its data read-only.
